title: doctor takes no argument
source: intended: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-22 and the doctor spec (defect N-20): a read-only health check
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20, B4.5). `jitso doctor x` is a usage error: exit 2, stderr `jitso doctor: takes no arguments`, nothing on stdout, no orca call. The oracle has no `doctor` command: it answers `unknown command "doctor"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every pinned line FAILS on it.
